name: Housewifery
body:
School universal; Level hedge witch 0

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as prestidigitation. For all intents and purposes it is exactly the same spell; hedge witches just call it by a different name and tend to use it for practical household purposes — stirring the stew, washing the dishes, cleaning the windows, etc.
